capabilities: Convert saved notes into .tex files by fixed rules
Compile the document automatically after each save
Preview edited sections in the PDF within about a second
Reorder and renumber chapter notes and update main.tex
Scroll the compiled PDF in sync with the note via SyncTeX
disambiguation: Not a LaTeX math renderer for notes; it converts whole folders of notes into a compiled LaTeX document and PDF.
extras: Desktop-only (compiling uses Node's child_process); free and open source (MIT) with no account, ads or telemetry; the plugin runs locally installed TeX tools and makes no network requests on desktop.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a set of notes written as one long document into a typeset LaTeX/PDF output.

relations.evidence: With the vault open in a browser through Ignis, the browser converts the notes and the PC compiles them.

requires.name: LaTeX distribution (TinyTeX, TeX Live, MiKTeX or MacTeX)

summary: Converts a folder of Markdown notes into a LaTeX document and compiles a typeset PDF that updates on each save.
